cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Concede the Point
cards.instruction: Get them to release one claim, advantage, or disputed victory without reopening the entire contest.

mechanism: Copy an avoid-this-place map mark as a recommendation, then salvage one limited acknowledgment while conceding the larger holiday claim.
confusable: Not merely arguing over credit: B2 must expose a mistaken copied mark and A3 must reinterpret its purpose without confession.
comparison: A route's indirect usefulness rather than uncertainty about a sporting result.
seedUse: Retains restaurant/holiday-credit narrow concession seed; creates closed-place map confusion and an open neighbor.
